lines.trans: Hello, Chef.
Here is where you are hiding!
Ainura, is that you?
Do not make noise so loudly, please.
I looked for you everywhere for a long time.
Sit down next to me, want a drink with me?
Oh, Chef, I am at work after all!
I still need to wash the floors.
Drop the work, rest a little.
You are sitting alone in the dark.
It is quiet here and nobody bothers me.
But you cannot stay here.

meanings.note: поставить громко = to put a phone on speaker

examples.text: Не говорите так громко, дети спят.
examples.trans: Don't speak so loudly, the children are asleep.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.text: Он всегда бросает вещи на пол.
examples.trans: He always throws things on the floor.

meanings.en: to hide oneself, to be in hiding

examples.trans: Children love hiding in the wardrobe.

meanings.note: остаётся у нас = stays with us

meanings.en: it is necessary, one needs to
meanings.note: + dative of the person + infinitive: мне нужно позвонить

examples.trans: I need to make a call.
Nothing can be seen in the dark.
I was born and grew up here.

нельзя.gloss: it is not allowed; one can't

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
to one person you call ты; здравствуйте is the polite form; the first в is silent
needs 'не' with the verb: никто не войдёт

examples.trans: I know the town like nobody else.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: Why are you sitting in the corner?

выпить.gloss: to drink, to have a drink

meanings.en: to drink up, to have a drink
meanings.note: often used without an object for drinking alcohol

examples.trans: Oh, I've had a bit to drink now.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.
I need to do a bit of work.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: Sit down and hold the door.

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

мешать.gloss: to be in the way, to disturb

meanings.en: to be in the way, to hinder

examples.trans: The radiators are in the way.

отдохнуть.gloss: to have a rest; to relax
